a: StatefulSets manage pods with stable identities and persistent storage.
DaemonSets run a pod on every node (or a subset) for agents/logging.
Jobs run finite tasks; CronJobs schedule Jobs on a timetable.
NetworkPolicies restrict pod-to-pod traffic like a firewall.
PodDisruptionBudgets limit voluntary disruptions during maintenance.
Requests schedule capacity; limits cap usage to protect neighbors.
Taints repel pods; tolerations allow pods onto tainted nodes.
Affinity/anti-affinity prefer or avoid placing pods together.
Service meshes (Istio/Linkerd) add mTLS, traffic policy, and observability.
Helm packages Kubernetes apps as charts with templates and values.
